question_en: How many of the TDocs are CRs? (change-request proportion).

minimum_fields.name: crs
minimum_fields.role: Requested number of CR instances under the original documented final CR census

adjudication: The explicit final original Appendix class-census authority, its direct V02/V01 connection to the CR share, cross-phase census definition, and matching original authored query resolve the Type/label/timing counterreadings in favor of the original independent class census. A genuine missing original policy is not established, so the prior clarification proposal is superseded rather than finalized.

strongest_counterreadings.issue: Type formation and final label census
strongest_counterreadings.strongest_counterreading: P1 §6 and §7.3 form CR from Type CR/draftCR/pCR; §11.1 says CR must have one of these types and §11.2 says Type-filter count. The complete frozen Type census differs from the class census, and five freshly reopened sources demonstrate that class/Type/body roles do not universally coincide.
strongest_counterreadings.adjudication: P1 L72 explicitly defines the CQ-related CR share as V02/V01; L643 points its instance-distribution CR count to V02. Appendix A is expressly an implemented measured census, with V02 defined as all :CR labels after cross-phase backfill/recovery and V16 reiterating that CR definition. This is a specific final population definition for the same named statistic, whereas Type rules govern initial formation and consistency. Therefore the latter do not license rebuilding or replacing the final class population for this metadata census. The original authored query independently uses the exact same two independent class counts. The frozen Type disagreements remain evidence about representation/source roles, not a second original answer meaning or alternative gold.

strongest_counterreadings.issue: Phase-1 timing and cross-phase CR-only records
strongest_counterreadings.strongest_counterreading: Phase1 §1.4–1.5 accepts only Tdoc-list Excel. CR is a Tdoc subclass, but 425 current CR nodes lack explicit Tdoc labels. The previous repair intersected labels and returned fewer instances.
strongest_counterreadings.adjudication: The same preserved Phase1 source explicitly includes Phase4 backfill in its final V02, keeps V01 as its own stated Tdoc population, and §13.3–13.4 defines cross-phase reuse of the owned counts. The original item has no as-of-Phase1-extraction timestamp. Its Phase1 identifier categorizes the metadata question and does not override that express final census. CR-only nodes must therefore remain in the numerator. No query-added explicit Tdoc intersection or subclass-closure union is authorized for this final statistic. This is established from affirmative source clauses, not from RDF inference or node-count convenience. Historical Appendix numeric values differ from this snapshot and are not reused.

strongest_counterreadings.strongest_counterreading: P1 demands unique Tdoc numbers and deduplication; exact stored identifiers contain 28 trailing-space alias pairs and some nodes lack generic id/title properties.
strongest_counterreadings.adjudication: Complete immutable SQL proves unique non-null exact tdocNumber within each applicable frozen identity domain and one node-label pair per identity. The original query counts stored instances, not a new trimmed identifier merge. P1 does not prescribe a repair-time cross-phase alias reconciliation. Thus no trim, property-presence exclusion, ID whitelist or source-version preference is inserted. These observations are retained as diagnostics, without claiming that every identifier is a different physical submission.

strongest_counterreadings.issue: Minimum requested answer versus proportion and two native columns
strongest_counterreadings.strongest_counterreading: The parenthetical change-request proportion and original query total/crs project a denominator, which could support requiring total, a ratio, or both.
strongest_counterreadings.adjudication: The interrogative asks How many ... are CRs, requiring the CR integer. The parenthetical names its statistical purpose and does not separately ask What fraction/percentage or request a second count. Retain the original full two-column query, including the source-defined Tdoc denominator, as reproducible context. Under the fixed no-extra-unrequested-projection rule require only crs; neither total nor a newly computed ratio becomes a mandatory answer field. A proportion alone does not replace the requested CR count. This agrees with the old minimum-role count-only derivation while correcting its population and field identity.

strongest_counterreadings.issue: External documents and graph-relative source context
strongest_counterreadings.strongest_counterreading: Some :CR nodes have non-form own source bodies, while two discussion/WID typed records have their own actual CR forms. A universal actual-document CR classification cannot be inferred from one scalar or label.
strongest_counterreadings.adjudication: The original EN is a dataset-statistics item with explicit original population authority and a final count definition; unlike technical approval/source-effect questions, it does not ask to reclassify physical submissions. Use that affirmative context to count the final represented CR class. Keep all five original byte-exact witnesses and the complete membership diagnostics, with no claim that the count certifies every physical document or that a missing formal cover proves not-CR. No mandatory body-form, approval, final-only or source-version policy is added.
